filter_source.ch4_reference: InfraTec LIM-262 pyroelectric methane detector NBP filter, CWL 3.3 um, FWHM 160 nm (~147 cm-1 at 3.3 um). Cited in MDPI Sensors 2012, doi:10.3390/s120912729.
